upstream_cardiovascular_eligibility.basis: Clinical eligibility criteria confirmed by the cohort builders

legacy_round2_descriptive_text_rules.scope: Round-two descriptive analyses of the four extract diagnosis fields and the primary procedure field. These rules were not the upstream eligibility query.

cancer_diagnosis_patterns.Endometrial: 子宫内膜(?:恶性肿瘤|癌|腺癌)
cancer_diagnosis_patterns.Prostate: 前列腺(?:恶性肿瘤|癌|腺癌)
cancer_diagnosis_patterns.Head and neck: 鼻咽癌|喉癌|口腔癌|甲状腺癌
